# BeadHub Documentation

> Technical docs for setting up and using BeadHub multi-agent coordination.

## Doc Pages

- [Getting Started](https://beadhub.ai/docs/getting-started/) — Install bdh, initialize a project, and get your first agents coordinating.
- [Concepts](https://beadhub.ai/docs/concepts/) — Workspaces, aliases, roles, projects, claims, reservations, and agent communication.
- [CLI Reference](https://beadhub.ai/docs/cli-reference/) — Complete command reference for bdh — coordination commands, task commands, and configuration.
- [Roles & Policies](https://beadhub.ai/docs/roles-and-policies/) — How project policies and role playbooks guide agent behavior in BeadHub.
